list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation). Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them; guides are our own words.
sourcesNote: Rebuilt 2026-11-20 from 7 cited sources (PowerPyx, Output Lag, KeenGamer, GTA-Zone, eGamers, Exophase, PSNProfiles). Every step carries per-step source citations; 49 trophies confirmed, 6 unconfirmed. PSNProfiles fetch was blocked (HTTP 403 on 2026-11-20), so it supplied no facts — the hidden-28 list was verified via Output Lag, GTA-Zone and eGamers instead. “OutputLog” does not exist; source 2 is Output Lag.

trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks on its own — there is no separate task behind it. The whole list is single-player and offline, so the platinum is purely a matter of finishing everything else.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Nothing here needs online play, DLC, or a difficulty setting.
Budget roughly 200 hours in total: 60–80 for the story, about 100 for the 100% checklist, and around 10 for cleanup.

trophies.answer: Collect the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks on its own — there is no separate task behind it.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the end of it. It is a story trophy, so you cannot miss it by playing normally.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: automatic story trophy tied to the opening mission Gone Fishing.

steps.text: Start a new game and play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
Follow the mission prompts to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
Story trophies like this one cannot be missed.

trophies.answer: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy lands just after the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?” It follows automatically from story progress.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: automatic story trophy tied to finishing Chapter 1.

trophies.answer: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy lands just after the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?”

trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: automatic story trophy tied to finishing Chapter 2.

Start Chapter 4 and complete its first two main missions, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life” — the trophy pops then.

trophies.answer: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”.

trophies.answer: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, “Starting From Zero”.

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission and this gold trophy pops. Guides disagree on which chapter the finale belongs to, but all agree on the requirement itself.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: automatic story trophy tied to the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save before it — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Play the story through to its final mission and complete it.
Automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.answer: Complete the final story mission and this gold trophy pops.
trophies.disagreement: Chapter attribution differs: PowerPyx ties the final mission to Chapter 4 'Starting From Zero' (the same mission it lists for Top Of The World, Ma — likely a site error); GTA-Zone places the finale in Chapter 5 and eGamers notes 'Beebom and CULTR word it as Chapter 5' with 'Sources differ on wording'. Core requirement (complete the final mission) is agreed by all.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which opens once the story is done — progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient, needing only about 60% true completion, but a few categories must be finished in full.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: 100% completion can be finished in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Finish the story first; the 100% checklist then appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Complete 100 optional tasks — there are 200–300+ available, and each meditation done with both characters counts as 2.
Hit the partial thresholds: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges, land 300 stunts, and earn 42 shooting-range golds.

Clear the full-requirement items: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 target decks, and 33 underwater discoveries — but note the 7 payday-loan jobs and the 33 underwater discoveries each come from a single guide, so treat those two counts as unconfirmed.
Finish the collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, and 100 WAiNK locations.

trophies.answer: Reach 100% completion on the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which opens once the story is done — progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the game’s 397 stunts. Under-bridge flights are the fastest category to farm.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stunts can be done any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts across the four categories: 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps — 397 in total.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest category to grind.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts; 300 stunts are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Land any 250 of the game’s 397 stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. Most of them happen naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: activities stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Do each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.
Check progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most types are introduced by the story or marked on the map with a blue dumbbell icon.
Expect most of them to come up on their own while you chase other trophies and the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every guide agrees on the 42 golds, but they disagree on how many ranges hold them — see the disagreement note.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the shooting range stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist.
Do not rely on a range count: PowerPyx and GTA-Zone say 12 ranges, while Output Lag says two ranges hold all 42 golds — only the 42 total is agreed.

trophies.answer: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.disagreement: Number of shooting ranges: PowerPyx and GTA-Zone say 42 golds across 12 ranges; Output Lag says 'there should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them'. The 42-challenge total is agreed by all five guides.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Take a drone-race win at all 14 Top Fun locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and all 42 are needed for 100%.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: drone races stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Score at least one win at every one of the 14 locations.
There are 42 drone races in total, and all 42 are needed for the 100% checklist.
Race locations show on the map once the area is unfogged.

trophies.answer: Take a drone-race win at all 14 Top Fun locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique races. Repeating a race you already won does not add to the count.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: races stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Win 20 different races; 40 unique races exist.
Winning the same race twice does not count toward the 20.
30 of the 40 race wins are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenge opens after the Chapter 1 mission where you meet him.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the fishing challenge can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui (Meet Cal)”.
Wait for Cal’s text; it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.answer: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games. You only need to clear its levels once; the extra challenges are optional.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: arcades stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Pick any of the 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three play on the TV at home, while Bang For Your Buck lives on arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of the game once; beating all of its challenges is not required.

trophies.answer: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s questline by completing her final mission. The strand is Lucia-only and stays open after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Andy’s questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: As Lucia in Chapter 3, wait for Andy’s call and the text with her Belville home address.
Complete the Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
Wrap up the final Andy mission; the whole strand remains open after the story.

trophies.answer: Finish Andy’s questline by completing her final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s questline by clearing all 7 shipwrecks he marks. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so the strand is not missable.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Kenton returns in Chapters 2–3; the questline stays open.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission “Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)”, answer his call; he is marked “KR” in Key Lento.
At his purple treasure markers, dive down and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the sea floor, then haul it back to Kenton.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his treasure sets; track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
Should he vanish after Chapter 1, give it until Chapters 2–3 — he comes back, and nothing here can be missed.

trophies.answer: Finish Kenton’s questline by clearing all 7 shipwrecks he marks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s questline by completing his final mission. The strand opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub and stays open after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Billy’s questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete the five Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
Finish the final Billy mission; the questline stays available after the story.

trophies.answer: Finish Billy’s questline by completing his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some strands count — the ones with their own trophies do not.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stranger strands stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Do not count on the Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, or Billy strands — each has its own trophy, so they do not add to the 8.
Do Yago’s timed race “Race Against Yago” as soon as it appears (hourglass icon, Chapter 3).
Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list after each strand.

trophies.answer: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s Wish List by delivering all 16 sports cars he wants. The strand unlocks with the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 and stays doable after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Randy’s Wish List stays doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs” to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy’s Wish List.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy’s list to his garage (green “RK” icon, west Vice City).
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check whether they are on the list; they are common in east Vice City and Ocean Beach.
Cars in good condition pay better, and the list lives under Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List.

trophies.answer: Finish Randy’s Wish List by delivering all 16 sports cars he wants.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s questline by completing his second quest, “Spin On This”. The strand is Jason-only and stays open after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Tyrone’s questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Play as Jason after the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”; Synthetic Labs are marked purple.
Destroy the labs in the quest “Take Out Kitty Litter”.
Complete Tyrone’s second quest “Spin On This” (Shut Down the Labs).

trophies.answer: Finish Tyrone’s questline by completing his second quest, “Spin On This”.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida’s 10 meditation locations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as soon as it appears — it may be required, and whether it counts is still unconfirmed.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation after “Down to Earth” — whether it is required is unconfirmed by all guides; keep a Chapter 1 save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after “Down to Earth”, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason’s house — speak to her in the kitchen in the morning, trail her out to the balcony, and pick Accept.
Work through all 18 spots at the 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia wherever you can — a spot covered by both counts double.
The final meditation needs both characters playable together, after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 15 of 18 suffice for 100%.

trophies.answer: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida’s 10 meditation locations.
trophies.disagreement: Spot/location arithmetic differs: PowerPyx says '18 Meditation Spots across 10 different locations' with +2 per spot for both characters; eGamers' 100% guide says '10 spots and 18 meditations' and notes 'Ten spots for two characters makes 20, not 18, and spot 1 is Jason-only in Chapter 1' — the numbers do not line up. The 18 total is agreed by PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTA-Zone and eGamers. Whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy is unconfirmed by ALL five guides.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — but which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed by every guide. The questline itself is well documented; only the final trigger animal is unknown.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the hunt can be retried from Bret's marker.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Play as Jason after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”; Bret texts to start “Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)” in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret asks for at the spots he marks, and carry them back to him as Jason.
Use the “Killtelligence SM-69” rifle Bret gives you; clean shots keep carcasses pristine and pay more.
Follow progress under Map > Activities > Target Deck; the 15 Target Decks are all needed for 100% — but since no guide names the trigger animal, just keep working through his requests.

trophies.answer: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — but which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed by every guide.
trophies.disagreement: Which animal unlocks the trophy is unconfirmed by every guide: PowerPyx says 'still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this'; GTA-Zone says 'the exact animal isn't confirmed yet'; eGamers lists 'Which animal is unconfirmed'. The questline facts themselves are agreed.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 cards in total). The smallest sets, at 12 cards each, are the fastest to finish.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: cards stay collectible in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Pick up cards wherever you find them — on indoor surfaces, in outdoor tool boxes, and in yellow phone boxes — until 3 sets are full.
Across 18 sets there are 480 cards, and the 12-card sets are the quickest to finish.
15 sets are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 cards in total).

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at any 100 locations. Any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, and tags counts.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: WAiNK locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Scan environment objects with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1).
The available pool is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — any 100 scans will do.
100 WAiNK locations are also required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: WAiNK It at any 100 locations.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. It pops automatically on the 100% route, since that route needs 70 of 80.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: challenges can be completed any time in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Track progress under Progress > Challenges; many complete naturally while working on other trophies.
70 of 80 challenges are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried any time with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: After Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) — guides disagree whether partner play opens after Coffee Break or Breakfast Run, but both are Chapter 2 missions.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Get clear of the red heat zone — merely leaving the flashing search area is not enough — and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the simplest way out.
Escaping a 4-star wanted level after a big bank vault robbery sets it off on its own.

trophies.answer: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat.
trophies.disagreement: When partner play unlocks: PowerPyx says free-roam together unlocks after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'; Output Lag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens 'right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2'. Both missions are in Chapter 2; the exact mission is disputed.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop — rob a fourth if it has not appeared.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried any time with your partner.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: After Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Hit 3 shops one after another without shaking the police off; keep the flashing wanted level alive across all three.
Grab the loot in each shop, and use sticky bombs on the back-room safe where you can.
Hang around about 30 seconds after stepping out of the 3rd shop; if nothing pops, hit a 4th shop.
Good location: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Chapter 3 “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs”.

trophies.answer: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — scanning alone counts; you do not need to drive them. PowerPyx alone puts the game’s total at 557 vehicles, so treat that figure as unconfirmed.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles can be discovered any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning counts as discovering.
Post up on a busy road and scan the traffic passing by until 100 different vehicles are logged.
Track progress under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%.

trophies.answer: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — scanning alone counts; you do not need to drive them.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Soldiers, police, and civilians do not count — use gang enemies.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried in any fight with enough enemies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm.
Buff focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle for accuracy and full-auto fire.
Line up 5 gang enemies — for example guards at an illegal operation — and defeat them in one activation.
Do not target soldiers, police, or civilians — they do not count.

trophies.answer: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane at VCIA and fly it away — an unscheduled departure. Only planes docked at a boarding bridge count; airfield-parked planes do not.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried any time at VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Head for VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and find a big passenger jet parked at a boarding bridge — gates E3/E4.
Enter the plane — stairs by the boarding bridge lead inside — and go upstairs to the cockpit.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport until the trophy pops.

trophies.answer: Steal a large passenger plane at VCIA and fly it away — an unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies with it until the trophy unlocks. The base sits at the south-west edge of the map, on Goose Key.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Rhinos can be found again in free roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County on Goose Key.
Tanks sit on the base’s south side — get in through the gate, or take the stunt jump near the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.answer: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies with it until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Snap Gun is the key tool — kicking the back door sets off the alarm.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried at a jewelry store any time.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Open the locked back door with the Snap Gun — kicking it sets the alarm off.
Inside the back room, track down the note with the safe code, empty the safe, wreck the security footage, and switch off the alarm.
Slip out unseen; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City makes a solid target.

trophies.answer: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%, and each one pays up to $205,000.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: bank vaults can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” to unlock bank vault robberies.
Shadow a security van to its bank and slip into the vault while it stands open; bring your partner along, since one person cannot haul all the cash.
For more vaults, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 (after his Payday Loan jobs).
Rob any 5 of the 8 vaults and escape; all 8 are needed for 100%.

trophies.answer: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 bank-vault mission counts as an armored-truck robbery, so it can cover this trophy too.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: armored trucks keep spawning in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” — its bank vault job counts.
Earlier alternative: cut off an armored truck near a bank, plant a bomb on its rear door, and blast it open.
Get out of the red heat radius — a Pay ‘n’ Spray works too — and the trophy will pop.

trophies.answer: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — flying a plane over the black-fog areas is fastest. No guide states how many areas Leonida has, so the 52-area figure in older data is unverified; chase a fully visible map, not a number.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: exploration can be finished any time in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

steps.text: Fully unfog the map of Leonida.
Sweep a plane across every black-fog patch until the whole map is uncovered.
Do not rely on the 52-area figure: no guide states an area count, so treat it as unverified.

trophies.answer: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — flying a plane over the black-fog areas is fastest.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. All 39 operations are needed for 100%.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: illegal operations can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Rob at least 1 illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
Yellow map icons mark operations when you are close; the story marks many of them for you on its own.
All 39 operations are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.answer: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — but the exact trigger is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives a method, and no other guide confirms it. Try the PowerPyx method, but do not treat it as settled.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Ocean Beach bars stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: PowerPyx-only method: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
No other guide confirms this trigger — treat it as single-source and unconfirmed.

trophies.answer: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — but the exact trigger is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives a method, and no other guide confirms it.
trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx (crawled 20 Nov 05:10 UTC) gives a specific method (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini); Output Lag, GTA-Zone, eGamers and KeenGamer all list the exact trigger as unconfirmed. GTA-Zone and eGamers explicitly state 'neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned [it] down yet' — that claim is stale against the current PowerPyx page, so the trigger is single-source, not confirmed.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — but the method is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives one, and no other guide confirms it. The showroom-window idea itself is only a guess elsewhere.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried at a vehicle showroom any time.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: PowerPyx-only method: obtain the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs”.
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City.
Drive it straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops shortly after.
No other guide confirms this — GTABase only guesses the showroom-window idea; treat it as single-source.

trophies.answer: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — but the method is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives one, and no other guide confirms it.
trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a specific method (blue Banshee, south Vice City showroom, Key Cloner required); Output Lag, GTA-Zone, eGamers and KeenGamer list it as unconfirmed. eGamers notes GTABase 'thinks Capital Offense involves crashing a car out through a showroom window' but neither is confirmed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and steal all 3 key valuables, then escape the police. If you miss an item, the operation respawns later, so the trophy is not missable.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Head to Kingpin Bowling (Kolt & Associates) in Port Gellhorn, stocking up on sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first.
Steal the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun (north-east table), and the office safe (blow it open with sticky bombs).
Escape the police; the trophy unlocks after the escape, not on pickup.
If items are missed, the operation respawns later — not missable.

trophies.answer: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and steal all 3 key valuables, then escape the police.

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Working out together trains both at once, since the partner trains alongside automatically.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Strength can be raised any time in free roam once both characters are playable.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: After Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, buy a gym membership — guides disagree whether partner play opens after Coffee Break or Breakfast Run, but both are Chapter 2 missions.
Train with both characters at once — call your partner over with hold Right + Triangle and they work out beside you.
Raise both characters’ Strength to maximum; check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.

trophies.answer: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The count fills passively during other trophies, and it can be farmed at the end if you are short.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: profile actions accumulate in free roam and can be farmed at the end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; the count is shown on the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see when actions count.
Robberies and enemy encounters feed it passively; avoid pushing to Irredeemable, which is permanent.
If still short, farm by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.answer: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
trophies.disagreement: eGamers flags the 500 count as 'single source' (GTABase), but PowerPyx independently states 500 actions, and GTA-Zone and Output Lag also state 500 — so two-plus independent sources agree.

trophies.guide: No guide knows how to unlock this trophy yet — there is no confirmed method. The only lead is an unconfirmed guess about a Payday Loans store, so do not chase it as if it were solved.
trophies.missableNote: No confirmed method exists yet, so missability is unknown.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: No confirmed method exists in any of the 5 guides.
PowerPyx’s unconfirmed guess points at the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba, Vice City — perhaps robbing it again later, in some particular way.
Do not present any method as confirmed — wait for the guides to pin it down.

trophies.answer: No guide knows how to unlock this trophy yet — there is no confirmed method.
trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx offers an unconfirmed guess (Payday Loans store, Little Cuba); Output Lag, GTA-Zone, eGamers and KeenGamer all list it as unconfirmed with no method.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists — three competing unconfirmed leads are circulating, and none has been verified. Try the leads if you like, but none of them is settled.
trophies.missableNote: No confirmed method exists yet, so missability is unknown.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: No confirmed method exists in any guide.

Lead A (PowerPyx): a UFO event on the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, solo — a blinking car may appear; follow the path into the woods to the UFO, help the abducted woman back to her car.
Lead B (Output Lag): a Crosstown building east of Pawn & Gun, where glowing graffiti hides a six-digit code that opens the ground-floor safe.

Lead C (Output Lag): Lucia may come across a UFO abduction side story in Chapter 2, linked to a keypad at the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake — a code many players report as not working.

trophies.answer: No confirmed method exists — three competing unconfirmed leads are circulating, and none has been verified.
trophies.disagreement: Three different proposed triggers from two sources, none confirmed: PowerPyx's Starlet Motel UFO event vs Output Lag's Crosstown graffiti-code safe vs Output Lag's Chapter 2 Lucia UFO abduction / Abandoned Site keypad. GTA-Zone, eGamers and KeenGamer list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl pedestrians over with a melee drive-by — but the method is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives one. Other guides still list the precise method as unconfirmed.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: can be retried any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: PowerPyx-only method: ride any bike in a crowded area (Vice City, Ocean Beach).
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
No other guide confirms this method.

trophies.answer: Bowl pedestrians over with a melee drive-by — but the method is unconfirmed: only PowerPyx gives one.
trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a specific method (bike, 10 pedestrian kicks with Square in 60 seconds); KeenGamer says 'Precise method still being confirmed', and Output Lag, GTA-Zone and eGamers list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so they move the total fast.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: marked bills keep coming from robberies in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew)” to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect marked bills.
Hand the marked bills to a fence until $250,000 has been laundered in total — Yasmani in Vice City offers the best rates.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each and count toward the total.

trophies.answer: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the priciest purchases and the fastest route.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops stay open and spending accumulates in free roam.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shop types.
Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the most expensive and fastest.
PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay ‘n’ Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, and 67 clothing stores.
The same count adds 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.answer: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, costing about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count — only the 8 you buy do.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: garage properties stay for sale in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 2 mission “Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)” to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the phone app (about $160,000 total).
The 4 story garages do not count toward the trophy.
Robberies bring in money fastest, above all the bigger jobs in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.answer: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, costing about $160,000 in total.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes, since each registration costs money and needs a free garage space.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles can be registered any time in free roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 2 mission “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)” to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first — each registration needs a free garage space.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; choose Respray, then Register.
Starting in Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at Pay ‘n’ Sprays instead; stick to cheap cars to keep the cost down.
Register 10 vehicles in total.

trophies.answer: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
